original_calibration.reason: prior first pass failed under old SafeWriter duplicate-class issue; target nonreach is inconclusive

source_path_argument: This existing @Test starts a two-DataNode MiniDFSCluster, creates a one-replica file, deliberately corrupts the local block, and raises replication to two at TestReplication.java:229-254. NameNode sends DNA_TRANSFER in a heartbeat response; BPOfferService processes that command and calls DataNode.transferBlocks (BPOfferService.java:731), which invokes DataNode.transferBlock (DataNode.java:2900), whose first action is getBPOSForBlock at DataNode.java:2834. The selected null-BPOfferService guard @1833 executes before the later corrupted-block detection, so it should be nonthrowing on a registered pool. Test asserts subsequent corruption reporting; that error is distinct from the selected missing-BPOS IOException.
advantages: Two DataNodes instead of ten. Explicit replication increase supplies a concrete NameNode-command to DataNode target path.
risks: The helper loops until the block is marked corrupt, so a fault can hang; enforce bounded trial timeout. Healthy exact target, named DN binding, command ancestry, and selected-throw absence remain unverified.
admission_gate: Run one isolated healthy JUnit under fixed SafeWriter agent; require Tests run>0, exact @1833 catalog/hit on named DN, zero selected IOException, complete trace, and a concrete pretarget NN heartbeat/command or DN I/O door before any fault trial.
